$comment: The demo catalog. Names, descriptions, sizes and prices are made up for this store. Each photo is from Unsplash or Pexels, free to use under their licenses, and shows a similar product rather than this exact one. 'u:' is an Unsplash photo id, 'p:' a Pexels photo id.

categories.name: Living Room
categories.description: Sofas, armchairs and tables for the room where everyone gathers.

products.name: Haven Corner Sofa
products.description: A deep L-shaped sofa with loose back cushions and a chaise on the left. The removable cover is a soft woven fabric that can be dry-cleaned.

products.name: Fjell Armchair
products.description: A compact armchair with a high back, button tufting and tapered oak legs. Small enough for a reading corner, firm enough to sit in for hours.

products.name: Velour Three-Seat Sofa
products.description: A low, generous sofa in deep green velvet with feather-wrapped seat cushions. The velvet has a light sheen that changes with the light.

products.name: Arbor Coffee Table
products.description: A rectangular coffee table in solid oak with rounded corners and a lower shelf for books and magazines. Finished with a hard-wearing natural oil.

products.name: Linea TV Bench
products.description: A long, low bench for a TV and speakers, with splayed solid wood legs and a cable opening at the back.

products.name: Sol Cane Lounge Chair
products.description: A low lounge chair with a woven cane seat and back on a solid beech frame. Light to move, and pairs well with a sheepskin.

products.name: Orbit Side Table
products.description: A round side table for a cup, a lamp or a plant, with a lipped top that keeps things from sliding off.

categories.name: Bedroom
categories.description: Beds, bedside tables and storage for a calm bedroom.

products.name: Nord Pine Bed Frame
products.description: A low platform bed in solid pine with a slatted base, so no box spring is needed. Fits a 160 × 200 cm mattress.

products.name: Cove Upholstered Bed
products.description: A padded bed with a tall headboard you can lean against to read. The fabric is a soft, durable weave. Fits a 160 × 200 cm mattress.

products.name: Pia Bedside Table
products.description: A small bedside table with two drawers that glide shut quietly. Wide enough for a lamp, a book and a glass of water.

products.name: Heritage Chest of Drawers
products.description: A chest of four deep drawers in walnut veneer with brass-finish handles. The drawers run on full-extension runners.

products.name: Washed Linen Duvet Set
products.description: A duvet cover and two pillowcases in stone-washed linen that gets softer with every wash. Double size: 200 × 220 cm cover, 50 × 70 cm pillowcases.

products.name: Aura Floor Mirror
products.description: A full-length mirror that leans against the wall. Comes with a safety strap to fix it to the wall.

products.name: Modu Wardrobe
products.description: A two-door wardrobe with a hanging rail and adjustable shelves inside. Add more units side by side as your storage grows.

categories.name: Kitchen & Dining
categories.description: Tables, chairs and the things that make a meal.

products.name: Lund Dining Table
products.description: A solid oak dining table that seats six. The oiled top shows the grain of the wood and can be sanded and re-oiled over the years.

products.name: Bistro Rattan Chair
products.description: A classic bistro chair with a bent wood frame and a woven rattan seat and back. Light, sturdy and comfortable for long dinners.

products.name: Tulip Round Dining Table
products.description: A round table for four on a single pedestal, so no table legs get in the way of anyone's knees.

products.name: Wire Counter Stool
products.description: A counter-height stool in welded steel wire with a footrest. Stacks for storage.

products.name: Terra Stoneware Dinner Set
products.description: A 16-piece set for four: dinner plates, side plates, bowls and mugs in reactive-glaze stoneware. Safe for the dishwasher and the microwave.

products.name: Ash Wall Shelf
products.description: A solid wood shelf with hidden brackets for spices, jars and cookbooks. Each shelf holds up to 15 kg when fixed to a solid wall.

products.name: Clip-Top Storage Jars
products.description: Four glass jars with clip lids and rubber seals that keep flour, pasta and spices fresh. 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 2 litres.

categories.name: Workspace
categories.description: Desks, chairs and storage for working from home.

products.name: Atlas Writing Desk
products.description: A simple solid wood desk with room for a laptop and a notebook, and a slim drawer for chargers and pens.

products.name: Rise Electric Standing Desk
products.description: A sit-stand desk with two quiet motors and three height memories. Moves between 72 and 120 cm in about 20 seconds.

products.name: Walnut Computer Desk
products.description: A wide desk in walnut veneer for two monitors, with a cable tray under the back edge to keep wires out of sight.

products.name: Ergo Mesh Office Chair
products.description: A breathable mesh chair with adjustable lumbar support, a headrest, 3D armrests and seat depth adjustment.

products.name: Shell Desk Chair
products.description: A moulded chair with a padded seat on solid beech legs. Works at a desk or around a dining table.

products.name: Track Wall Shelving
products.description: Wall rails with adjustable brackets and shelves. Move the shelves up and down as your storage needs change.

products.name: Curve Office Cabinet
products.description: A walnut cabinet with rounded sides and a soft-close door. Holds files, a printer and everything else that clutters a desk.

categories.name: Lighting
categories.description: Floor, table and ceiling lamps for warm light in every room.

products.name: Tripod Floor Lamp
products.description: A floor lamp on three wooden legs with a fabric drum shade that spreads a soft, even light.

products.name: Brass Task Lamp
products.description: A table lamp in brushed brass with a tilting dome shade. Directs light onto a desk or a bedside book.

products.name: Rattan Pendant Lamp
products.description: A hand-woven rattan shade that casts patterned shadows on walls and ceiling. Hang a few at different heights over a table.

products.name: Swing-Arm Desk Lamp
products.description: A classic spring-balanced desk lamp. The arm and head move freely and stay exactly where you leave them.

products.name: Clear Globe Pendant
products.description: A mouth-blown clear glass globe on a fabric cord. Looks best with a warm filament bulb.

products.name: Arc Floor Lamp
products.description: A long arched floor lamp that reaches over a sofa or a reading chair, on a heavy base that keeps it steady.

products.name: Drum Shade Floor Lamp
products.description: A slim floor lamp with a wide linen drum shade, for a gentle light beside a sofa or in a bedroom corner.

categories.name: Storage
categories.description: Shelves, cabinets and baskets that keep things in their place.

products.name: Shelf Bookcase
products.description: A tall open bookcase with five shelves, deep enough for large books and records. Can be fixed to the wall for safety.

products.name: Mid Sideboard
products.description: A low sideboard with sliding doors and adjustable shelves for tableware, records or games.

products.name: Cube Shelf Unit
products.description: A shelf unit of eight open cubes. Use it as a bookcase or a room divider, or add baskets to hide the clutter.

products.name: Woven Seagrass Baskets
products.description: A set of two hand-woven seagrass baskets with handles, for blankets, toys or laundry.

products.name: Hallway Storage Bench
products.description: A bench to sit on while putting on shoes, with space underneath for shoes or baskets.

products.name: Coat Hook Rail
products.description: A wall rail with five sturdy hooks for coats, bags and hats.

products.name: Bamboo Plant Stand
products.description: A tiered stand for plants on three levels, so even a small corner can hold a small garden.
